name: pcb-kicad
description: Checks a KiCad printed circuit board: KiCad's own design rule check and connectivity, library pin names against nets, and trace heating per IPC-2221.
settles: silkscreen clipped by the board edge
lenses: what a design rule check cannot see
a connector that fits the wrong cable
origin: extracted from an autonomous board pipeline that generated, routed and DRC-checked two 4-layer boards headlessly; its chat logs and history showed which checks caught real defects and which passed defects a person later found. The KiCad knowledge is generic (file format, kicad-cli, the stock libraries); no project's design came with it.
